newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: RODAMCO TO BUY BARCLAYS' BRITISH PROPERTY.
newsitem.headline: RODAMCO TO BUY BARCLAYS' BRITISH PROPERTY.

text.p: Property investment fund Rodamco NV said on Monday it was at an advanced stage of negotiations with Britain's Barclays Bank Plc on the takeover of Barclays' IMRY British property portfolio.
"The negotiations are expected to be completed within a few weeks," Rodamco said without giving details about the value of the property to be bought.

Rodamco said it had also swapped its 12 percent stake in Corporate Property Investors (CPI) in the U.S. for interests in three shopping malls owned by CPI, plus an additional cash payment of $10 million.
The transaction involves a total amount of roughly $340 million, Rodamco said, adding the exchange would make a direct contribution to the growth of its net profits per share.
The net cash return on the malls exceeds the dividend yield on the CPI shares formerly held by Rodamco by more than one percent, the property arm of the Robeco group of investment funds said.
Rodamco said it had made its first purchase in Singapore where it took a 25 percent stake in a development project for 70 million Singapore dollars or about 90 million guilders.

"Including other new purchases ... total investments made in the current 1996/97 financial year amount to around 2.0 billion guilders, without taking into account the takeover of the aforementioned IMRY portfolio," Rodamco said.
It added that its divestments in the current year had totalled nearly 0.5 billion guilders.
